description: Wire loadAllQuestions() into LOS Tracker, Revision Planner, Insights, and Search Modal - replacing the 50-question sampleQuestions import with the full 1,283-question data set. This gives these features access to all subjects, topics, and readings from the real question bank.
steps: In src/features/los-tracker/components/los-tracker-content.tsx: Replace 'import { sampleQuestions } from @/features/question-bank/data/sample-questions' with 'import { loadAllQuestions } from @/features/question-bank/utils/question-loader'. Change the LOS_ITEMS IIFE to call loadAllQuestions() instead of iterating sampleQuestions. Since loadAllQuestions() requires client-side window, wrap LOS_ITEMS creation inside the component using useMemo, not at module level. The SUBJECTS derivation similarly moves inside the component.

In src/features/revision/components/revision-planner.tsx: Replace sampleQuestions import with loadAllQuestions. Change ALL_SUBJECTS to be derived from loadAllQuestions() inside the component via useMemo. Change the inner loop that finds questions by ID to use the full question set.

In src/features/insights/components/insights-content.tsx: Replace sampleQuestions import with loadAllQuestions. Wrap the question lookup (find by questionId) to use loadAllQuestions(). Pass the full question set to WeakTopicPanel.
In src/features/search/components/search-modal.tsx: Replace sampleQuestions import with loadAllQuestions. Ensure search indexes all 1,283 questions.
Run bun run tsc --noEmit to verify no type errors.
acceptance_criteria: grep -rn 'from.*sample-questions' src/ returns zero results (no file should import sampleQuestions directly anymore except the question-loader itself)
LOS Tracker derives topics from all 1,283 questions (not just 50)
Revision Planner has all 10 CFA subjects (not just the subset from 50 sample questions)
Insights page can look up any of the 1,283 questions by ID
verification: Run: bun run tsc --noEmit - expect exit 0
Run: bun run vitest --run - expect same or better pass count
